Poly Haven permits copying, modifying and redistributing this asset, including commercial use, without attribution.
The bundled tree is a modified, optimized version of the official source.
Original bark/leaf textures are retained at 1k; leaves use an alpha mask.
Geometry is reduced to two detail levels for real-time street rendering.
Asset provenance, modifications and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in provenance.json.
This model does not establish the real tree species or planting positions in Gangnam.
